CustomStreamConnectors.description: A list of Custom Stream Connectors.

value.description: A list of Custom Stream Connectors.

CreateCustomStreamConnectorRequest.description: The request payload for creating a Custom Stream Connector.

displayName.description: The Custom Stream Connector display name. The display name must follow naming rules according to item type.

description.description: The Custom Stream Connector description. Maximum length is 256 characters.

folderId.description: The folder ID. If not specified or null, the Custom Stream Connector is created with the workspace as its folder.

definition.description: The Custom Stream Connector public definition. Providing a `definition` is optional; when supplied, the Custom Stream Connector is created with that content. If it is omitted, the Custom Stream Connector is created without a definition and its content can be supplied later through the update definition API. This item type does not support `creationPayload`.
